history.text: The Medicine Lodge Treaty is signed by southern Great Plains Indian leaders. The treaty requires Native American Plains tribes to relocate to a reservation in the western Indian Territory.
history.title: Medicine Lodge Treaty
history.description: 1867 resettlement agreement between the US government and southern Plains Indian tribes
